Done. PR #171 is now `MERGEABLE` / `CLEAN`.

## What I found

Refreshed via `gh` at the start of the request:

- **PR #171** — `feat(registry): add tempmail dashboard`, author `miantiao-me` (COLLABORATOR), state `OPEN`, base `master`, head `agili-app:automation/pi/tempmail-167` (in-repo assistant branch matching `automation/pi/`). It was reported `CONFLICTING` / `mergeStateStatus: DIRTY` — in scope as a merge conflict in an assistant PR.
- Diff: 3 files, +16 lines (`README.md`, `README.zh-CN.md`, one new `tempmail` entry appended to `registry/sources.json`), no comments.
- Cause: master had since merged #170 (`beszel`), which appended a new dashboard entry at the same place, so all three files conflicted as append-vs-append.

## What I changed

Checked out the existing head branch `automation/pi/tempmail-167`, merged `origin/master` into it, and resolved the conflicts by **keeping both** accepted changes, with source data preserved byte-for-byte:

- `registry/sources.json` — kept master's `beszel` entry unchanged, then the PR's `tempmail` entry unchanged (same ID, repository, path, author, license, commit, version `0.1.0`, and SHA-256). Verified: 17 entries, no duplicate IDs, both IDs match `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`, valid JSON.
- `README.md` / `README.zh-CN.md` — kept the `beszel` row (master) and added the `tempmail` row (PR) after it; table columns still align at the existing width in both files, translations preserved as the PR wrote them.

No blanket ours/theirs was used. Formatting: `vp fmt --config "$RUNNER_TEMP/pi-format.json" --disable-nested-config` on the three files (no changes needed), then `--check` passed; `git diff --check` and `git diff --cached --check` both clean before committing. Nothing was executed besides the formatter — no installs, scripts, or tests run.

## Commit and push

- Merge commit `333e05b` — `chore(registry): merge latest master into automation/pi/tempmail-167` (two parents: `74b5241` PR head, `4dde986` master).
- Pushed to the same branch: `74b5241..333e05b  HEAD -> automation/pi/tempmail-167` (fast-forward, no force push).
- Net diff of the PR vs `master` is unchanged in intent: +1 row in each README, +14 lines for the `tempmail` registry entry.
- GitHub now reports `mergeable: MERGEABLE`, `mergeStateStatus: CLEAN` for https://github.com/agili-app/Awesome.Metrix.Bar/pull/171.

I did not push to `master`, create/review/merge any PR, or edit PR metadata — the PR is left ready for maintainers to merge. Other queued assistant branches (`agy-resets-166`, `antigravity-162`, `beszel-168`, `trmnl-bar-164`) were not touched, since this event was for #171 only.
